description: Locations is a map-and-list directory of places. Location records live in buildfire.publicData under the collection 'locations' and category records under 'categories', so both are app-wide and readable by any plugin in the app; the instance configuration document lives in buildfire.datastore under 'settings', scoped to this plugin instance, and is only read here, to honor its subscription and bookmark switches; nothing in this contract writes it. Locations are hard-deleted; categories are soft-deleted, and only records whose _buildfire.index.date1 (a mirror of deletedOn) is null are live. Operations typed publicData are declarative: their platform call is built at invoke time from context.query with $params.* interpolation, so they have no counterpart in plugin.contract.js. Operations typed function live in plugin.contract.js on the widgetContract object, are dispatched by context.functionName, and take (options, callback); they name a location or category by its exact title and refuse a title that matches nothing or more than one record, and every server-run write is made as the app, never as a named app user. The six context.hosts values mean: 'generic' touches no buildfire API and no host state, so it evaluates anywhere; 'headlessSdk' uses buildfire and chains several steps, with the headless SDK providing buildfire on the server; 'widgetForeground' and 'widgetBackground' are confined to the iframe under the app, Foreground when the operation drives visible UI or must not run unwatched; 'controlForeground' and 'controlBackground' are confined to the iframe under the control panel on the same distinction. generic and headlessSdk run on the server and are exposed to the MCP; controlForeground, controlBackground, widgetForeground and widgetBackground are excluded from it. Here only the two bookmark operations are widget-hosted (widgetBackground), because bookmarks belong to the signed-in session. Location writes made through this contract do not register a deep link and do not record analytics, both of which only the plugin's own frames can do; they keep the in-app search engine in step where that service is available and report whether they did.

events.name: locationCreated
events.description: Emitted after a new location is saved, from the app, the control panel or this contract.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the new location.

events.name: locationUpdated
events.description: Emitted after a location's details are edited and saved, from the app, the control panel or this contract.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the edited location.

title.description: The location title after the edit.

events.name: locationDeleted
events.description: Emitted after a location is permanently deleted, including when an app owner upholds an abuse report against it.

locationId.description: The publicData record id the deleted location had.

events.name: locationSubscribed
events.description: Emitted after an app user starts following a location to receive its notifications.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the location.

userId.description: The app user who followed it.

events.name: locationUnsubscribed
events.description: Emitted after an app user stops following a location.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the location.

userId.description: The app user who stopped following it.

events.name: locationBookmarked
events.description: Emitted after the signed-in app user bookmarks a location.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the location.

bookmarkId.description: The id the bookmark is stored under, which is the location's clientId.

events.name: locationUnbookmarked
events.description: Emitted after the signed-in app user removes a location from their bookmarks.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the location.

bookmarkId.description: The id the bookmark was stored under.

events.name: locationRated
events.description: Emitted after an app user rates a location and its rating summary is saved.

locationId.description: The publicData record id of the location.

average.description: The location's average rating after this one.

count.description: The number of ratings the average is drawn from.

operations.name: searchLocations
operations.description: Finds locations in the app, alphabetically, optionally narrowed by name, search words, category, who added them, whether they are featured, or whether they are open at a given time.

title.description: Optional exact location title. Defaults to unset, which returns locations of every title. With it, every location sharing that title is listed, which is what distinguishes them when an operation that takes a title reports the title as matching several.

searchText.description: Optional text matched case-insensitively against the title, subtitle, address, formatted address and address alias, as the widget's search box does; category names are not matched. Defaults to unset, which applies no text filter.

categoryTitle.description: Optional exact title of a live category, keeping only locations filed under it. Defaults to unset, which applies no category filter.

subcategoryTitle.description: Optional exact title of a subcategory inside categoryTitle, keeping only locations filed under that subcategory. Needs categoryTitle. Defaults to unset.

creatorUserId.description: Optional app user, by id or email, keeping only the locations they added, as the intro list's My Locations mode does. Defaults to unset, which returns locations by every creator.

pinnedOnly.description: When true, keeps only the locations pinned to the intro screen's three featured slots, as the intro carousel shows them, and orders them by slot. Defaults to false.

openAt.description: Optional ISO instant; when given, keeps only locations whose opening hours cover it, as the widget's open-now filter does. Defaults to unset, which applies no opening-hours filter.

pageSize.description: Records per page; defaults to 50, the size the widget pages with. Values above 50 are capped at 50.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the matching locations or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when a category or subcategory title matches nothing or several records; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

locations.description: The matching locations, alphabetically by title, or in pin-slot order when pinnedOnly is true.

formattedAddress.description: The address as the map formatted it.

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address; null when none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists; null when none.

categories.description: The categories it is filed under, as category record ids.

views.description: How many times the detail screen was opened.

pinIndex.description: Pin slot 1-3 on the intro screen; null when not pinned.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the location was last saved.

total.description: Total number of matching locations across all pages.

page.description: The zero-based page index this result is.

hasMore.description: Whether more matching locations exist past this page.

operations.name: searchLocationsNearPoint
operations.description: Lists the locations closest to a spot on the map, nearest first, with how far away each one is.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point to measure from.

longitude.description: Longitude of the point to measure from.

pageSize.description: Records per page; defaults to 50, the size the widget pages with. Values above 50 are capped at 50.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the nearest locations or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

formattedAddress.description: The address as the map formatted it.

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address; null when none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists; null when none.

categories.description: The categories it is filed under, as category record ids.

views.description: How many times the detail screen was opened.

pinIndex.description: Pin slot 1-3 on the intro screen; null when not pinned.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the location was last saved.

distance.description: Distance from the point, in meters.

operations.name: getLocation
operations.description: Shows one location's details, including its categories and whether it is open at a given time.

title.description: The exact title of the location to read, as shown in the app.

at.description: The moment to judge open-or-closed at. Defaults to now; pass it explicitly to keep the call deterministic.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the location or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one, or when at is not a valid timestamp; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

formattedAddress.description: The address as the map formatted it.

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address; null when none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists; null when none.

subscriberCount.description: Number of app users following the location.

views.description: How many times the detail screen was opened.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the location was last saved.

categories.description: Titles of the main categories it is filed under.

subcategories.description: Titles of the subcategories it is filed under.

openNow.description: Whether it is open at the moment tested, by its opening hours in UTC.

isOpen.description: True when the weekday is active and the moment falls inside one of its intervals.

operations.name: createLocation
operations.description: Adds a new location to the app's map and lists on behalf of the app, where every app user can see it right away.

subtitle.description: A short subtitle. Defaults to none.

formattedAddress.description: The address as it should be displayed. Defaults to the address.
formattedAddress.sampleValue: 600 F St, San Diego, CA 92101, USA

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address. Defaults to none.

description.description: The description; HTML is allowed. Defaults to none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists. Defaults to none.

categoryTitle.description: The exact title of a category to file it under. Defaults to none.

subcategoryTitle.description: The exact title of a subcategory of that category to file it under too. Defaults to none; needs categoryTitle.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the new location or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when a category or subcategory title matches nothing or more than one, or when a subcategory is given without a category; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

location.description: The location as stored after the call.

formattedAddress.description: The address as the map formatted it.

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address; null when none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists; null when none.

subscriberCount.description: Number of app users following the location.

views.description: How many times the detail screen was opened.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the location was last saved.

searchIndexSynced.description: Whether the in-app search engine was updated; false where that service is unavailable.

operations.name: updateLocationDetails
operations.description: Changes a location's name, address, map position, description or picture on behalf of the app, keeping anything not given as it was.

title.description: The exact title of the location to edit, before any rename, as shown in the app.

newTitle.description: A new title. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current title.

subtitle.description: A new subtitle. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

address.description: A new street address. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

formattedAddress.description: A new display address. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.
formattedAddress.sampleValue: 610 F St, San Diego, CA 92101, USA

addressAlias.description: A new address alias. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

description.description: A new description; HTML is allowed. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

listImage.description: A new list image URL. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

latitude.description: A new latitude. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

longitude.description: A new longitude. Defaults to unset, which keeps the current one.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the edited location or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one, or when newTitle is empty; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

location.description: The location as stored after the call.

formattedAddress.description: The address as the map formatted it.

addressAlias.description: An alternative display name for the address; null when none.

listImage.description: URL of the image shown in lists; null when none.

subscriberCount.description: Number of app users following the location.

views.description: How many times the detail screen was opened.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the location was last saved.

searchIndexSynced.description: Whether the in-app search engine was updated; false where that service is unavailable.

operations.name: deleteLocation
operations.description: Permanently removes a location from the app's map and lists for every app user, with no way to restore it.

title.description: The exact title of the location to delete, as shown in the app.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the deletion result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

title.description: The title of the deleted location.

searchIndexCleared.description: Whether its search-engine entry was removed; false where that service is unavailable.

operations.name: deleteLocationSubscriber
operations.description: Stops a person from following a location, on behalf of the app, so they no longer receive its notifications.

title.description: The exact title of the location to unfollow, as shown in the app.

userId.description: The app user who stops following, by id or email.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one, or when the user cannot be found; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

userId.description: The app user id removed from its followers.

wasSubscribed.description: False when the user was not following, so nothing changed.

operations.name: sendLocationNotification
operations.description: Sends a push notification, on behalf of the app, to everyone following a location, which reaches real people and cannot be taken back.

title.description: The exact title of the location whose followers are notified, as shown in the app.

message.description: The notification's text, up to 300 characters.
message.sampleValue: Half-price pastries with any coffee until 6pm.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one, when the location has no followers, when the message is over 300 characters, or when subscriptions or custom notifications are disabled for this instance; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

notifiedUserCount.description: How many followers the notification was sent to.

operations.name: createLocationBookmark
operations.description: Adds a location to the signed-in app user's bookmarks.

title.description: The exact title of the location to bookmark, as shown in the app.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one, or when location bookmarks are disabled for this instance; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

alreadyBookmarked.description: True when it was already bookmarked, so nothing changed.

operations.name: deleteLocationBookmark
operations.description: Removes a location from the signed-in app user's bookmarks.

title.description: The exact title of the location to remove from bookmarks, as shown in the app.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no location or more than one; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

wasBookmarked.description: False when it was not bookmarked, so nothing changed.

operations.name: searchCategories
operations.description: Lists the categories people can filter locations by, alphabetically, optionally only those with a given name.

title.description: Optional exact category title. Defaults to unset, which returns every live category.

pageSize.description: Records per page; defaults to 50, the size the widget pages with. Values above 50 are capped at 50.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the matching categories or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

iconUrl.description: URL of the category icon image; null when it uses an icon class.

iconClassName.description: CSS class of the category icon; null when it uses an image.

operations.name: createCategory
operations.description: Adds a new category that locations can be filed under and filtered by.

iconClassName.description: A CSS icon class for the category. Defaults to none.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the new category or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

iconClassName.description: Its icon class; null when none.

operations.name: updateCategoryTitle
operations.description: Renames a category everywhere it appears in the app.

title.description: The exact current title of the category.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no live category or more than one; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

operations.name: deleteCategory
operations.description: Removes a category from the app's filters while keeping it behind the scenes, and leaves the locations filed under it unchanged.

title.description: The exact title of the category to delete.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with the result or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including when the title matches no live category or more than one; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

title.description: The title of the deleted category.
